jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international organisation operating within the real estate, construction, and professional services sector. With a strong global presence and a reputation for excellence, the company delivers innovative property solutions in a collaborative, diverse, and forward-thinking environment focused on operational excellence and sustainable growth.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of design and construction projects
• Establish and manage project budgets, forecasting, and funding requests
• Build and lead multidisciplinary project teams
• Manage procurement processes for consultants, contractors, and suppliers
• Coordinate internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle
• Monitor project performance, KPIs, reporting, and governance processes
• Lead change management activities and manage project modifications
• Conduct contractor evaluations, tender reviews, and award recommendations

• Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, or related discipline
• Minimum 5 years of experience in project management within construction, engineering, real estate, or a related environment
• Proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
• Demonstrated leadership and team management experience
• Fluent in English and French or Dutch

Join a dynamic and fast-growing international company where innovation, entrepreneurship, and ambition are at the heart of everything. You'll have the opportunity to build a global network, make a real impact, and accelerate your career in an inspiring environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients.
• Develop and manage your own client portfolio.
• Identify and approach new business opportunities.
• Understand clients' needs and provide tailored solutions.
• Conduct market research and monitor industry trends.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer satisfaction.
• Represent the company during meetings, events, and client visits.

• Bachelor's degree minimum.
• Fluent in French or Dutch, with a good command of English.
• Ambitious, energetic, and driven by results.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Not afraid of client contact or commercial challenges.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive attitude.
• Eager to learn and build a successful career in sales and account management.

Zij zijn een innovatieve en groeiende speler in de verse voedingssector, waar kwaliteit, duurzaamheid en teamwork centraal staan. In een dynamische omgeving krijg je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Samen bouwen ze elke dag aan sterke resultaten én een succesvolle toekomst.

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.

What will you do?

• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics and maintenance teams to ensure smooth daily operations.
• Follow up on employee performance, coaching and development.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
• Ensure products meet the highest quality standards and customer expectations.

Who are you?

• You have experience in a supervisory role within a production, packaging or food manufacturing environment.
• You are a strong people manager who can motivate, coach and develop teams.
• You remain calm under pressure and can effectively prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• You have an interest in production processes and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English; knowledge of Romanian is an asset.
• You are quality-focused, hands-on and solution-oriented.
• You understand the flexibility required in a fresh food environment where quality and customer service are key.

Place of Employment - Machelen

Jobomschrijving

Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region. 

We offer an initial fixed-term contract of 1 month, starting on 1 September, allowing sufficient time for onboarding and knowledge transfer followed by a replacement contract covering a maternity leave and subsequent absence.

The total expected assignment duration is approximately 12 months.

Your Role:

As an Air Export Administrative Agent, you will be responsible for the accurate and timely processing of air export shipments while ensuring excellent customer service throughout the shipment lifecycle. You will work closely with customers, airlines, and internal departments to guarantee smooth and efficient operations. 

Key Responsibilities:

Air Freight Administration

• Track and trace air export shipments through online systems and email communication.
• Manage and process shipment-related documentation accurately. 
• Upload shipment documents into electronic document management systems.
• Support the handling of shipment pre-alerts and storage requirements, including temperature-sensitive shipments. 
• Follow up on active container leasing and end-of-lease activities. 
Customer Service

• Inform customers proactively about shipment status updates and delays.
• Respond professionally to customer inquiries.
• Ensure customer requirements and operating procedures are consistently respected. 
Compliance & Operational Excellence

• Escalate operational issues to management when necessary.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency and service quality.
• Ensure compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
• Follow up on operational discrepancies and system-related issues.
• Assist with claim notifications to airlines when required. 

Your Profile:

We are looking for a motivated logistics professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment.

Requirements

• Knowledge of the air freight process and transport documentation.
• A background in Transport & Logistics or a similar education is highly valued.
• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
Proactive and able to work independently. 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.

• Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written).
• Strong communication skills with both customers and colleagues.
Personal Qualities

• Customer-focused and service-minded.
• Flexible and willing to go the extra mile when operational needs require it.
• No strict "9-to-5" mentality.
• Professional attitude and willingness to follow company procedures, policies, and dress code.
• Strong team player with a positive mindset.

jobs.occupation: Comptable AP Team leader English and French
jobs.description:
Our client is an international company located in Liege.

Jobomschrijving

As an AP Team Leader Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Supervise and manage the accounts payable team to ensure smooth operations.
• Mentoring and training Junior Accountants to support their professional development and strengthen their technical accounting skills.
• Oversee invoice processing and payment approvals in compliance with company policies.
• Coordinate with internal departments and external vendors to resolve payment discrepancies.
• Maintain accurate records of all accounts payable transactions.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and internal controls.
• Prepare and review reports related to accounts payable performance.
• Support month-end and year-end closing processes as required.
• Propose process improvements to enhance efficiency in the accounts payable function.

A successful AP Team Leader Accountant should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Experience in accounts payable or similar financial operations roles.
• Strong organisational and team management skills.
• Proficiency in Excel.
• Knowledge of French and English.
• Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
• Good communication skills for liaising with vendors and internal teams.
• Problem-solving abilities to address payment or process issues effectively.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Residence in Liege.

jobs.occupation: Freelance Accountant and Internal Control Consultant
jobs.description:
Our client is a construction company.

Jobomschrijving

Accounting

• Manage day-to-day accounting activities for one or several entities.
• Prepare and review monthly, quarterly and annual closings.
• Perform balance sheet reconciliations and ensure the accuracy of accounting records.
• Monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable and general ledger postings.
• Prepare VAT declarations and support other tax compliance obligations.
• Assist in the preparation of statutory accounts and audit files.
• Coordinate with external auditors, accountants and tax advisors.
• Ensure compliance with Belgian accounting standards and company policies.
Internal Control

• Assess and document existing financial and operational processes.
• Identify control weaknesses and propose pragmatic improvement actions.
• Ensure proper segregation of duties and compliance with internal procedures.
• Review approval workflows, authorizations and financial governance processes.
• Support the implementation and monitoring of internal control frameworks.
• Perform periodic control testing and follow-up on remediation actions.
• Participate in risk assessments and recommend mitigating measures.
• Support finance leadership in strengthening audit readiness and compliance.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or Economics.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting combined with exposure to internal control, audit or compliance activities.
• Experience from construction, real estate or architect companies (must have).
• French and English.

We're looking for an IT Coordinator to play a key role in a fast-evolving Benelux environment. You'll combine hands-on IT expertise with project leadership, supporting critical business systems while driving strategic initiatives across ERP, e-commerce, cloud, and business applications.

Jobomschrijving

• Drive local and international IT projects, including ERP and digital platform transformations.
• Support and optimize business-critical applications such as ERP, e-commerce, CRM, and customer support tools.
• Act as the go-to expert for users, system integrations, and operational excellence.
• Ensure IT infrastructure, security, compliance, and data protection remain robust and future-ready.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external technology partners to deliver seamless digital experiences.

• 5  years of experience in IT systems, applications, or project management.
• Strong ERP expertise; SAP experience is a major plus.
• Knowledge of e-commerce platforms (Shopify is a bonus).
• Broad understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud services, and user support.
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills.
• Fluency in Dutch and English; French is an asset.

Our client is a leading international group active in industrial solutions. Operating in a dynamic Benelux environment, they combine global standards with local agility. They are looking for an EHS Specialist to strengthen safety culture, support operations and projects, and drive continuous improvement across multiple entities.

Jobomschrijving

• Champion a strong safety and environmental culture
• Maintain and improve EHS systems (ISO 45001, ISO 14001, VCA)
• Support projects with safety methodologies (HAZOP, RAMS, PSSR)
• Act as EHS point of contact for operational field teams
• Conduct risk assessments, audits, and site safety reviews
• Investigate incidents and define preventive measures
• Deliver EHS training and awareness programs
• Ensure compliance with BE/NL regulations and reporting

• 2  years in EHS within an industrial or service environment
• Strong knowledge of safety regulations (Belgium required, NL is a plus)
• Experience with EHS management systems (ISO 45001 / VCA)
• Familiar with project safety tools (HAZOP, RAMS…) is a plus
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a strong asset
• Autonomous, pragmatic, and hands-on mindset
• Strong communicator with influencing skills

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing organisation operating within a highly technical and project-driven production environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Assess the manufacturability and technical feasibility of customer-approved designs, identifying risks, constraints, and optimisation opportunities.
• Create and maintain production documentation including technical drawings, CAD models, work instructions, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ERP master data.
• Provide technical support to production teams, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and contribute to root cause analyses and corrective actions.
• Optimise designs, materials, and production processes to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance manufacturing performance.
• Collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, Product Management, and Engineering teams to ensure technical alignment and operational excellence.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Engineering, Design Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, technical design, or a similar production-focused role.
• Strong proficiency with CAD software (such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Inventor) and experience managing BOMs, routings, and technical master data in ERP systems (SAP, Dynamics, or similar).
• Solid understanding of manufacturing processes, design for manufacturability principles, technical problem solving, and cost estimation within an industrial environment.
• Analytical, detail-oriented, and hands-on professional with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple departments.
• Fluent in English and Dutch

Our client is an innovative international technology company developing advanced solutions in a highly regulated and engineering-driven environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead, coach, and support team members in their professional growth and development.
• Build and maintain a high-performing team through recruitment, onboarding, workforce planning, and retention initiatives.
• Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Ensure effective team delivery by managing capacity, workload, planning, and operational effectiveness.
• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and other stakeholders to strengthen Agile practices and improve overall team performance.

• Proven experience in people management, team leadership, coaching, or talent development.
• Strong interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills with the ability to build trust and engagement.
• Experience working in Agile, technical, engineering, or other multidisciplinary environments.
• Ability to balance people management, operational delivery, and organizational priorities while adapting to change.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of French is considered an asset.

Our client is one of the world's leading specialist HR consultancies. Help candidates build meaningful careers and support businesses in finding the talent they need to succeed. Joining the Brussels office means becoming part of a high-performing, collaborative team where entrepreneurship, development, and achievement are celebrated every day.

Jobomschrijving

• Developing and managing your own portfolio of clients within your specialist market.
• Identifying new business opportunities and expanding existing partnerships.
• Advising clients on recruitment strategies, salary benchmarks, and talent market trends.
• Sourcing, screening, and interviewing qualified candidates.
• Guiding candidates throughout the recruitment process and supporting them in their career development.
• Matching top talent with suitable opportunities.
• Negotiating offers and managing placements from start to finish.
• Achieving individual and team targets within a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment.
•  

• Bachelor's or Master's degree holders.
• Passionate about people, business, and career development.
• Strong communicators with excellent interpersonal skills.
• Commercially minded, ambitious, and results-driven.
• Resilient and proactive, with a positive attitude and a desire to succeed.
• Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
• Fluent in English and Dutch and/or French.

Our client is a well-established company operating within an international environment. Known for its customer-focused approach and operational excellence, the company is looking to strengthen its Supply Chain department with a motivated and detail-oriented Purchasing & Supply Chain Officer.This role offers the opportunity to work closely with suppliers, sales teams, and supply chain professionals while contributing to the smooth flow of daily operations.

Jobomschrijving

As a Purchasing & Supply Chain Officer, you will provide key administrative support to the purchasing and supply chain teams and help ensure an efficient and reliable supply process.Your responsibilities include:

• Processing and monitoring purchase orders and supplier information
• Following up on delivery schedules and supplier commitments
• Ensuring accurate data management within the ERP system
• Identifying and reporting supply-related issues or discrepancies
• Supporting Supply Chain Planners with backorders and ongoing deliveries
• Assisting the sales team with product availability and lead-time inquiries
• Maintaining smooth communication between suppliers and internal departments
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of supply chain processes

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience
• Initial experience in purchasing, supply chain, logistics administration or a similar role
• Fluent in Dutch with a good professional knowledge of French and English
• Experience working with ERP systems
• Good Excel skills
• Strong organizational and administrative abilities
• Accurate, structured and detail-oriented
• Proactive and solution-driven mindset
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills

An organisation operating in the public sector.

Jobomschrijving

As an Accountant AZ your responsibilities are:

• Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and public sector regulations.
• Manage accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in the preparation of budgets and financial forecasts.
• Coordinate with external auditors and provide necessary documentation.
• Reconcile bank statements and monitor cash flow activities.
• Prepare and submit tax declarations and other regulatory filings.
• Provide financial insights and support decision-making processes.

A successful Bilingual Accountant should have:

• Proficiency in accounting principles and financial reporting.
• Strong knowledge of Winbooks.
• Fluency in English and French.
• Strong knowledge of public sector financial regulations.
• Residence in Brussels.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Experience at least 1 year in accounting.
• Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving skills.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines efficiently.

Our client is a well-established retail organization operating a large network of specialized stores across Belgium. With a strong focus on customer service and operational excellence, the company relies on robust IT solutions to support its stores and central services. To support ongoing growth and digital transformation initiatives, our client is looking for an IT Onsite Support to strengthen its IT team.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Onsite Support, you will play a key role in supporting both store operations and corporate services. Acting as a first point of contact for IT-related issues, you will help ensure the smooth functioning of business-critical systems while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives:

• Provide 1st and 2nd line IT support to stores and central services, primarily remotely and occasionally on-site.
• Monitor the performance and availability of Point-of-Sale (POS) systems and coordinate issue resolution with internal or external stakeholders.
• Ensure accurate ticket logging, tracking, and follow-up through the company's service desk platform.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of POS and ERP-related functionalities.
• Create, update, and maintain user documentation and operational procedures.
• Participate in the development and enrichment of the internal knowledge base.
• Identify potential risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Support testing activities and system enhancements as your expertise develops.

• Strong motivation to learn and develop expertise in business applications and IT systems.
• Hands-on, proactive mindset with a customer-focused approach.
• Ability to work collaboratively while taking ownership of assigned tasks.
• Open to feedback and continuous improvement.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central is mandatory.
• Experience within a retail environment is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch. French & English are an advantage.
• Willing to participate in an on-call rotation system (with appropriate compensation).
• Eager to learn and grow within a dynamic team environment.

jobs.occupation: Administrative Assistant - Real Estate - Full Time or 4/5th
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company managing an extensive real estate portfolio across Belgium.The company offers a stable environment, a collaborative culture and the opportunity to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact across the country. They are located in Diegem and easily accessible by car, tram, bus and train.

Jobomschrijving

• Support administration and follow-up of lease renewals, acquisitions and ongoing property files.
• Review contracts, interpret and gather relevant information.
• Manage correspondence and DocuSign signature processes.
• Ensure accurate filing and document management.
• Follow up with landlords regarding contractual and administrative matters.
• Support invoice processing and administrative reporting.
• Prepare reports, presentations and meeting documentation.
• Coordinate with various internal stakeholders and ensure proper follow-up of actions.

• A few years of experience in an administrative, coordination, file managment or property-related support role.
• Exposure to property management, lease administration, real estate, notary or similar environments is a strong asset.
• Proactive; organised and adaptable personality, able to support different stakeholders and managers.
• Professional level French and Dutch, with a good level of English.

Our client is a leading international corporate real estate company. You will join a company offering a stable environment, strong team spirit and opportunities to develop your skills. They are located in Diegem close to a train station in a new modern building.

Jobomschrijving

As Meetings & Event Coordinator, you will ensure successful planning and execution of meetings and events.

• Coordinate and support delivery of meetings, conferences and events from planning to execution.
• Prepare and set up meeting rooms and event spaces.
• Coordinate guest services, catering, transportation and other event-related logistics.
• Manage meetings and events calendar and contribute to post-event reporting and follow-up.
• Support in general office management.

• First experience in events, hospitality, office management or administration is a plus (internships included).
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Service-oriented mindset and professional communication skills.
• Proactive, hands-on and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word and Excel).

This position is within the property industry and based near Ternat.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting to the Accounting Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring and analysing operational expenses and project-related costs.
• Managing and overseeing the invoice and purchase order cycle.
• Reviewing accounting entries, allocations, and VAT-related controls.
• Supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
• Performing variance analysis and preparing financial reporting for key stakeholders.
• Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and audit processes.
• Ensuring compliance with accounting standards and internal control procedures.
• Contributing to process improvements, financial systems enhancements, and European-wide projects.
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive transparency, efficiency, and cost optimisation.
• Supporting knowledge-sharing and collaboration within the finance team.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 4-5 years of experience in accounting or financial reporting.
• Previous experience within a services, retail, or similar operational environment.
• Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.
• Experience with SAP; S4Hana knowledge is considered a strong asset.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Good knowledge of IFRS and/or local GAAP standards is an advantage.
• Fluent English communication skills; additional European languages are a plus.
• Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.
• Comfortable working in an international and fast-paced environment

Our client is a globally admired design-driven company. They're based in the North of Brussels and looking for an AR Accountant to strengthen the team.

Jobomschrijving

• Follow up on Customer Accounts
• Intervene when there are issues with invoices
• Be a contact person for clients
• Make reports on blocked orders
• Be a part of the AR / AP Accounting team

• 2-3 years of experience in Accounting / Credit Control
• Fluent in English, ideally some Dutch or French as well
• Problem solving, hands-on mentality

Our client is a leading player in the packaging and industrial solutions sector, recognized for its innovation, operational excellence and commitment to sustainable manufacturing.With a strong footprint across Europe and ambitious growth plans, the company is looking to strengthen its commercial presence within the DACH region (Germany, Austria & Switzerland) through the recruitment of a highly driven Business Development Manager.This opportunity is ideally suited to a true sales developer, someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, opening new doors and driving market expansion rather than simply managing existing relationships.

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and execute a commercial growth strategy for the DACH region.
• Identify, prospect and convert new customers across targeted industrial sectors.
• Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline.
• Develop long-term relationships with key decision-makers.
• Understand customer needs and propose tailored technical solutions.
• Lead negotiations and successfully close commercial agreements.
• Collaborate closely with internal technical, operational and customer service teams.
• Represent the company at trade fairs, industry events and customer meetings.
• Monitor competitor activity and market trends.
• Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM reporting.

We are looking for a real business developper.The successful candidate will demonstrate:

• Proven experience in Business Development, Technical Sales or B2B Commercial Development.
• A genuine passion for acquiring new customers and opening new markets.
• Strong prospecting, networking and relationship-building skills.
• An entrepreneurial mindset with a high degree of autonomy.
• Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.
• The resilience and determination required to develop business within a competitive market.
Experience within packaging, manufacturing, industrial products, paper, printing, labels, plastics or other technical environments is considered a strong advantage.German is the key success factor for this role.Given the strategic focus on the DACH region, candidates must possess:

• Perfect proficiency in German
• Professional French and/or English
• Additional languages are an asset
You must be capable of conducting negotiations, presentations and commercial discussions at senior decision-maker level entirely in German.
